name: @nebutra/forge-dns-leak
description: Authoritative DNS leak zone + session API for Nebutra Forge (dnsleaktest-style recursive resolver capture)

nebutra.summary: UDP/TCP53 authority that logs recursive resolvers for unique leak probes; localhost control API for Forge
gaps: Requires a delegated authoritative zone — NS records at the registrar, DNS-only at Cloudflare — before any probe resolves
Six FORGE_DNS_LEAK_* variables configure the DNS and API listeners; there are no defaults that work off a clean checkout
Sessions are held in an in-process Map, so probe results do not survive a restart or span replicas
